def _remembered_route_detail(self, raw_id, item, base_vod):
        route = item.get("last_play_route") if isinstance(item.get("last_play_route"), dict) else {}
        play_id = str(route.get("playId") or "").strip()
        resource_id = str(route.get("resourceId") or item.get("alist_vod_id") or "").strip()
        resource_mode = str(
            route.get("resourceMode") or item.get("alist_resource_mode") or "vod"
        ).strip().lower()
        season = self._positive_int(route.get("season"), 0)
        episode = self._positive_int(route.get("episode"), 0)
        backend = str(route.get("backend") or "").strip()
        if backend and backend != self._resource_capability_identity():
            return None
        if (
                not play_id or not resource_id or not season or not episode
                or resource_mode not in self.RESOURCE_SEARCH_MODES
                or not self._resource_id_persistable(resource_id, resource_mode)
                or not re.match(r"^(?:\d+@[^\s?#]+|\d+-\d+|\d+)$", play_id)
                or self._contains_url_reference(self._unquote_limited(play_id))):
            return None
        if resource_mode == "plugin" and self._atvp_plugin_play_context(play_id) is None:
            # The persisted handle is safe, but its raw plugin play ID is memory-only.
            # Fall through to the bound resource detail so the same handle is rebuilt.
            return None
        history_episode = str(item.get("history_episode") or "").strip()
        route_episode = "S%02dE%02d" % (season, episode)
        if history_episode and history_episode != route_episode:
            return None
        name = str(route.get("name") or route_episode).strip()[:256]
        provider = self._resource_provider_key(
            route.get("resourceProvider"), item.get("alist_resource_provider"), resource_id,
        )
        followplay = self._build_followplay(
            play_id, item, resource_id, season, episode, name,
            resource_mode=resource_mode, resource_provider=provider,
        )
        if not followplay:
            return None
        merged = self._merge_resource_vods(
            [{
                "vod_play_from": "上次成功线路",
                "vod_play_url": "%s$%s" % (name, followplay),
                "resource_id": resource_id,
                "_resource_mode": resource_mode,
                "group_seasons": [season],
                "group_providers": [provider],
                "group_quality": [dict(route.get("quality") or {})],
            }],
            item, raw_id, base_vod, preferred_resource_id=resource_id,
        )
        if merged:
            self._schedule_entry_resource_preheat([item])
        return merged

    def _bound_replacement_key(self, item, bound_resource_id):
        identity = str(item.get("tmdb_id") or item.get("source_id") or "").strip()
        backend = self._resource_capability_identity()
        raw = "%s|%s|%s" % (backend, identity, str(bound_resource_id or "").strip())
        return "bound-replacement:" + hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

def _follow_preheat_current_item(self, fallback):
        fallback = dict(fallback or {})
        items = self._follow_memory.get("items") if isinstance(self._follow_memory, dict) else {}
        if not isinstance(items, dict):
            return fallback
        tmdb_id = self._positive_int(fallback.get("tmdb_id"), 0)
        source_id = str(fallback.get("source_id") or "").strip()
        current = items.get(str(tmdb_id)) if tmdb_id else None
        if not isinstance(current, dict) and source_id:
            current = next((
                value for value in items.values()
                if isinstance(value, dict) and str(value.get("source_id") or "").strip() == source_id
            ), None)
        return dict(current) if isinstance(current, dict) else fallback

        item = self._follow_preheat_current_item(item)
        route = item.get("last_play_route") if isinstance(item.get("last_play_route"), dict) else {}
        play_id = str(route.get("playId") or "").strip()
        resource_id = str(route.get("resourceId") or item.get("alist_vod_id") or "").strip()

            route.get("resourceMode") or item.get("alist_resource_mode") or "vod"
        ).strip().lower() or "vod"
        season = self._positive_int(route.get("season"), 0)
        episode = self._positive_int(route.get("episode"), 0)
        backend = str(route.get("backend") or "").strip()
        if backend and backend != self._resource_capability_identity():
            return False
        if (
                not play_id or not resource_id or season <= 0 or episode <= 0
                or resource_mode not in self.RESOURCE_SEARCH_MODES
                or not self._resource_id_persistable(resource_id, resource_mode)

    def _follow_preheat_snapshot(self):
        items = [
            item for item in (self._follow_memory.get("items") or {}).values()
            if isinstance(item, dict) and str(item.get("title") or "").strip()
        ]
        ready = sum(1 for item in items if self._follow_route_binding_ready(item))
        with self._cache_lock:
            state = getattr(self, "_follow_preheat_state", None)
            state = dict(state) if isinstance(state, dict) else {}
            pending = list(state.get("pending") or [])
            active = dict(state.get("active") or {})
            total = self._positive_int(state.get("total"), 0) or len(items)
            processed = min(total, self._positive_int(state.get("processed"), 0))
            route_jobs = len(self._route_probe_jobs)
            started_at = self._positive_int(state.get("started_at"), 0)
            running = bool(started_at and (pending or active or route_jobs or processed < total))
        return {
            "total": total,
            "processed": processed,
            "ready": min(total, ready),
            "route_jobs": route_jobs,
            "running": running,
            "started_at": started_at,
        }

    def _start_follow_preheat_all(self, items):
        source_items = []
        identities = set()
        for source in items or []:
            if not isinstance(source, dict) or not str(source.get("title") or "").strip():
                continue
            item = dict(source)
            tmdb_id = self._positive_int(item.get("tmdb_id"), 0)
            if tmdb_id and not item.get("source_id"):
                item["source_id"] = "tmdb:tv:%s" % tmdb_id
            if tmdb_id and not item.get("media_type"):
                item["media_type"] = "tv"
            identity = self._entry_resource_preheat_key(item)
            if not identity or identity in identities:
                continue
            identities.add(identity)
            source_items.append(item)
        with self._cache_lock:
            current = getattr(self, "_follow_preheat_state", None)
            current = current if isinstance(current, dict) else {}
            current_running = bool(
                current.get("generation") == self._cache_generation
                and (current.get("pending") or current.get("active") or self._route_probe_jobs)
            )
            if current_running:
                result = self._follow_preheat_snapshot()
                result["accepted"] = False
                return result
            self._follow_preheat_state = {
                "generation": self._cache_generation,
                "total": len(source_items),
                "pending": source_items,
                "active": {},
                "targets": set(identities),
                "completed": set(),
                "processed": 0,
                "resource_failed": 0,
                "started_at": int(time.time()),
                "draining": False,
            }
        self._drain_follow_preheat_batch()
        result = self._follow_preheat_snapshot()
        result["accepted"] = True
        return result

    def _drain_follow_preheat_batch(self):
        with self._cache_lock:
            state = getattr(self, "_follow_preheat_state", None)
            if (
                    not isinstance(state, dict)
                    or state.get("generation") != self._cache_generation
                    or state.get("draining")):
                return
            state["draining"] = True
        try:
            while True:
                with self._cache_lock:
                    state = getattr(self, "_follow_preheat_state", None)
                    if not isinstance(state, dict) or state.get("generation") != self._cache_generation:
                        return
                    pending = state.get("pending") if isinstance(state.get("pending"), list) else []
                    if not pending or len(self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs) >= self.RESOURCE_ENTRY_PREHEAT_LIMIT:
                        break
                    item = dict(pending.pop(0))
                    key = self._entry_resource_preheat_key(item)
                current = self._follow_preheat_current_item(item)
                if self._follow_route_binding_ready(current):
                    self._complete_follow_preheat_resource(current, True)
                    continue
                ready_rows = self._ready_resource_rows(current)
                if ready_rows:
                    self._complete_follow_preheat_resource(current, True)
                    continue
                with self._cache_lock:
                    state = getattr(self, "_follow_preheat_state", None)
                    if not isinstance(state, dict) or state.get("generation") != self._cache_generation:
                        return
                    state.setdefault("active", {})[key] = item
                    already_running = key in self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs
                if already_running:
                    continue
                scheduled = self._schedule_entry_resource_preheat([item])
                if scheduled:
                    continue
                ready_rows = self._ready_resource_rows(item)
                self._complete_follow_preheat_resource(item, bool(ready_rows))
        finally:
            with self._cache_lock:
                state = getattr(self, "_follow_preheat_state", None)
                if isinstance(state, dict):
                    state["draining"] = False
                    restart = bool(
                        state.get("pending")
                        and len(self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs) < self.RESOURCE_ENTRY_PREHEAT_LIMIT
                    )
                else:
                    restart = False
            if restart:
                self._drain_follow_preheat_batch()

    def _complete_follow_preheat_resource(self, item, resource_ready):
        item = self._follow_preheat_current_item(item)
        key = self._entry_resource_preheat_key(item)
        if resource_ready and not self._follow_route_binding_ready(item):
            try:
                self._warm_follow_item_route(item, self._ready_resource_rows(item))
            except Exception:
                pass
        with self._cache_lock:
            state = getattr(self, "_follow_preheat_state", None)
            if not isinstance(state, dict) or state.get("generation") != self._cache_generation:
                return
            targets = state.get("targets")
            if not isinstance(targets, set):
                targets = set(targets or [])
                state["targets"] = targets
            if key not in targets:
                return
            active = state.get("active") if isinstance(state.get("active"), dict) else {}
            active.pop(key, None)
            completed = state.get("completed")
            if not isinstance(completed, set):
                completed = set(completed or [])
                state["completed"] = completed
            if key in completed:
                return
            completed.add(key)
            state["processed"] = len(completed)
            if not resource_ready:
                state["resource_failed"] = self._positive_int(state.get("resource_failed"), 0) + 1
        self._refresh_follow_categories()
        self._drain_follow_preheat_batch()

                or not self.route_preheat
                or not self.atvp_api
                or not self.atvp_token
                or self._atvp_session is None):
            return False
        source_items = list(items or (self._follow_memory.get("items") or {}).values())
        source_items = [dict(item) for item in source_items if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("title")]
        for item in source_items:

            if tmdb_id and not item.get("source_id"):

            if tmdb_id and not item.get("media_type"):
                item["media_type"] = "tv"

            source_items = source_items[start:start + self.follow_page_size]

            0 if str(item.get("alist_vod_id") or "").strip() else 1,
            0 if self._has_follow_update(item) else 1,
            str(item.get("next_air_date") or "9999"),
            str(item.get("title") or ""),
        ))

        for item in source_items[:self.RESOURCE_ENTRY_PREHEAT_LIMIT]:

                continue
            key = self._entry_resource_preheat_key(item)

                    # detail request can race with category/init preheat and
                    # must still render the honest background-validation state.
                    scheduled = True

                if len(self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs) >= self.RESOURCE_ENTRY_PREHEAT_LIMIT:
                    break

                generation = self._cache_generation
                self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs[key] = owner
            expected_resource_id = str(item.get("alist_vod_id") or "").strip()

            def worker(
                    source_item=item, cache_key=key, job_owner=owner,
                    expected_generation=generation, expected_bound=expected_resource_id):
                first_refreshed_groups = 0
                try:
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + self.RESOURCE_HOT_VALIDATION_BUDGET
                    candidates = self._resource_candidates(
                        source_item, deadline=deadline, background=True,
                        expected_generation=expected_generation,
                    )
                    candidates = self._checked_resource_rows(
                        candidates[:self.RESOURCE_HOT_VALIDATION_ATTEMPT_LIMIT], deadline,
                    )

                    def publish_partial(current):
                        nonlocal first_refreshed_groups
                        if self._cache_ready_resource_rows(
                                source_item, current,
                                expected_generation=expected_generation,
                                cache_key=cache_key):
                            group_count = self._validated_resource_group_count(current)
                            if group_count > 0 and first_refreshed_groups <= 0:
                                first_refreshed_groups = group_count
                                self._schedule_active_detail_refresh(source_item)

                    all_playable = self._playable_resource_rows(
                        candidates, source_item, deadline,
                        expected_generation=expected_generation,
                        on_update=publish_partial,
                    )
                    target_row = self._target_covering_resource_row(all_playable, source_item)
                    playable = list(all_playable[:self.RESOURCE_HOT_ROUTE_LIMIT])
                    if target_row is not None and all(
                            str(row.get("vod_id") or row.get("id") or "")
                            != str(target_row.get("vod_id") or target_row.get("id") or "")
                            for row in playable):
                        if playable:
                            playable[-1] = target_row
                        else:
                            playable = [target_row]
                    if self._cache_ready_resource_rows(
                            source_item, playable,
                            expected_generation=expected_generation,
                            cache_key=cache_key):
                        target_row = self._target_covering_resource_row(playable, source_item)

                                not expected_bound

                                != expected_bound):
                            self._replace_bound_resource(
                                source_item, target_row,
                                expected_generation=expected_generation,
                                expected_bound_resource_id=expected_bound or None,
                                expected_item_resource_id=expected_bound,
                            )
                        final_group_count = self._validated_resource_group_count(playable)
                        if final_group_count > first_refreshed_groups:
                            self._schedule_active_detail_refresh(source_item)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                finally:
                    with self._cache_lock:
                        if self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.get(cache_key) is job_owner:
                            self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.pop(cache_key, None)

            try:
                submitted = self._submit_background_bulkhead_task(
                    "resource_completion", generation, worker,
                    "resource-entry-preheat", executor=self._resource_search_executor)
            except Exception:
                with self._cache_lock:
                    if self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.get(key) is owner:
                        self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.pop(key, None)
                continue
            if submitted:
                scheduled = True
            else:
                with self._cache_lock:
                    if self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.get(key) is owner:
                        self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.pop(key, None)
                break
        return scheduled

            0 if str(item.get("alist_vod_id") or "").strip() else 1,
            0 if self._has_follow_update(item) else 1,
            str(item.get("next_air_date") or "9999"),
            str(item.get("title") or ""),
        ))
        scheduled = False
        for item in source_items[:self.RESOURCE_ENTRY_PREHEAT_LIMIT]:
            if self._ready_resource_rows(item):
                continue
            key = self._entry_resource_preheat_key(item)
            with self._cache_lock:
                if key in self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs:
                    # Treat an already-running job as accepted. A foreground
                    # detail request can race with category/init preheat and
                    # must still render the honest background-validation state.
                    scheduled = True
                    continue
                if len(self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs) >= self.RESOURCE_ENTRY_PREHEAT_LIMIT:
                    break
                owner = object()
                generation = self._cache_generation
                self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs[key] = owner
            expected_resource_id = str(item.get("alist_vod_id") or "").strip()

            def worker(
                    source_item=item, cache_key=key, job_owner=owner,
                    expected_generation=generation, expected_bound=expected_resource_id):
                first_refreshed_groups = 0
                resource_ready = False
                try:
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + self.RESOURCE_HOT_VALIDATION_BUDGET
                    candidates = self._resource_candidates(
                        source_item, deadline=deadline, background=True,
                        expected_generation=expected_generation,
                    )
                    candidates = self._checked_resource_rows(
                        candidates[:self.RESOURCE_HOT_VALIDATION_ATTEMPT_LIMIT], deadline,
                    )

                    def publish_partial(current):
                        nonlocal first_refreshed_groups
                        if self._cache_ready_resource_rows(
                                source_item, current,
                                expected_generation=expected_generation,
                                cache_key=cache_key):
                            group_count = self._validated_resource_group_count(current)
                            if group_count > 0 and first_refreshed_groups <= 0:
                                first_refreshed_groups = group_count
                                self._schedule_active_detail_refresh(source_item)

                    all_playable = self._playable_resource_rows(
                        candidates, source_item, deadline,
                        expected_generation=expected_generation,
                        on_update=publish_partial,
                    )
                    if self._atvp_plugin_candidate_gap(all_playable, source_item):
                        plugin_deadline = min(
                            deadline,
                            time.monotonic() + self._positive_int(
                                self.ATVP_PLUGIN_CANDIDATE_POLICY.get("preheat_budget"), 40,
                            ),
                        )
                        plugin_candidates = self._atvp_plugin_candidates(
                            source_item, deadline=plugin_deadline,
                            expected_generation=expected_generation,
                        )
                        plugin_checked = self._checked_resource_rows(
                            plugin_candidates[:self.RESOURCE_HOT_VALIDATION_ATTEMPT_LIMIT],
                            plugin_deadline,
                        )
                        base_playable = list(all_playable)

                        def publish_plugin_partial(current):
                            combined = self._resource_output_candidate_order(
                                base_playable + list(current), source_item,
                                bound=self._resource_binding_resource_id(source_item),
                                modes=self.RESOURCE_SEARCH_MODES,
                            )
                            publish_partial(combined)

                        plugin_playable = self._playable_resource_rows(
                            plugin_checked, source_item, plugin_deadline,
                            expected_generation=expected_generation,
                            on_update=publish_plugin_partial,
                        )
                        if plugin_playable:
                            all_playable = self._resource_output_candidate_order(
                                base_playable + list(plugin_playable), source_item,
                                bound=self._resource_binding_resource_id(source_item),
                                modes=self.RESOURCE_SEARCH_MODES,
                            )
                    target_row = self._target_covering_resource_row(all_playable, source_item)
                    playable = list(all_playable[:self.RESOURCE_HOT_ROUTE_LIMIT])
                    if target_row is not None and all(
                            str(row.get("vod_id") or row.get("id") or "")
                            != str(target_row.get("vod_id") or target_row.get("id") or "")
                            for row in playable):
                        if playable:
                            playable[-1] = target_row
                        else:
                            playable = [target_row]
                    if self._cache_ready_resource_rows(
                            source_item, playable,
                            expected_generation=expected_generation,
                            cache_key=cache_key):
                        resource_ready = True
                        target_row = self._target_covering_resource_row(playable, source_item)
                        if target_row and (
                                not expected_bound
                                or str(target_row.get("vod_id") or target_row.get("id") or "").strip()
                                != expected_bound):
                            self._replace_bound_resource(
                                source_item, target_row,
                                expected_generation=expected_generation,
                                expected_bound_resource_id=expected_bound or None,
                                expected_item_resource_id=expected_bound,
                            )
                        final_group_count = self._validated_resource_group_count(playable)
                        if final_group_count > first_refreshed_groups:
                            self._schedule_active_detail_refresh(source_item)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                finally:
                    with self._cache_lock:
                        if self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.get(cache_key) is job_owner:
                            self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.pop(cache_key, None)
                    self._complete_follow_preheat_resource(source_item, resource_ready)
                    self._refresh_follow_categories()

            try:
                submitted = self._submit_background_bulkhead_task(
                    "resource_completion", generation, worker,
                    "resource-entry-preheat", executor=self._resource_search_executor)
            except Exception:
                with self._cache_lock:
                    if self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.get(key) is owner:
                        self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.pop(key, None)
                continue
            if submitted:
                scheduled = True
            else:
                with self._cache_lock:
                    if self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.get(key) is owner:
                        self._resource_entry_preheat_jobs.pop(key, None)
                break
        return scheduled
